sources.title: shriwastav/Qwen-Image-2.1-Uncensored-GGUF · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Node Configuration: Diffusion Model: Add the Unet Loader (GGUF) node and select your downloaded .gguf file. Text Encoder: Add the standard CLIPLoader node, select qwen3vl_8b_bf16.safetensors (or int8), and set type to qwen_image. VAE: Add the standard VAELoader node and select qwen_image_2.1_vae_bf16.safetensors.
